    About

    16 Oct patch: as of today 100 green pumpkins are active. The 300 from the previous days are no longer valid, so older "spawned" reports no longer count as open.

    Every green and red Halloween pumpkin in Financial and Waterfront.

    Green pumpkins: about 1,000 spots per district. 50 new ones open per district every day at 00:00 UTC and stay until you destroy them, so you can catch up on missed days. Each one counts once. Red pumpkins: 50 per district, hidden all event, found once.

    Made by Eaxium Area borders traced from the community maps by XtremeLaw Version Community version with player photos and reports

    San Paro Pumpkin Map

    16 Oct patch: as of today 100 green pumpkins are active. The 300 from the previous days are no longer valid, so older "spawned" reports no longer count as open.

    A community map of every green and red Halloween pumpkin spot in Financial and Waterfront, made by Eaxium from the APB Reloaded game files.

    • Tap a pumpkin for pictures, its height and how to reach it from the street.
    • Route planner (route icon, or ☰ on phones): set where you are and get the shortest way through the spots you still need.
    • Mark destroyed as you go. Your marks stay in this browser; Saved lets you move them to another device.
    • Contributors with a key post photos and "spawned" reports so everyone can see which spots are open.
